newsitem.title: INDIA: Bombay cotton prices recover on fresh mill buying.
newsitem.headline: Bombay cotton prices recover on fresh mill buying.

text.p: Bombay cotton prices recovered on Friday on fresh mill buying as well as less arrivals, dealers said.
Arrivals fell as farmers were bringing in less quantities.

In spot deals Bengal-deshi rose by 5/10 rupees to 800/835 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) while Punjab saw-ginned rose by 10/15 rupees to 1,365/1,615 rupees. Gujarat cotton however remained steady in thin activity.
Gujarat Sankar-4 was quiet at 16,500/17,500 rupees per candy (355.56 kg) for the average variety and at 18,000/18,500 rupees per candy for the superior variety.
